title: Preview: Kingsmead FC visit Ember Park
summary: Everything you need to know before Saturday week.
body: Kingsmead FC arrive at Ember Park on 24 October sitting fourth in the table.
Tickets are on sale now. See the tickets page for prices and how to buy.

title: Hale and Otieno lead a 4-2 win over Westfield City
summary: Four goals at Ember Park keep Ascindrix second in the table.
body: Ascindrix FC beat Westfield City 4-2 at Ember Park, with Viktor Hale scoring twice and Jamal Otieno adding a goal and an assist.
Westfield pulled one back before half-time, but Marco Silva's second-half set pieces put the game out of reach.
The result moves the club to second in the league, five points behind Stonebridge Athletic.

title: Match report: Stonebridge Athletic 2-0 Ascindrix FC
summary: A first league defeat of the season on the road.
body: Ascindrix suffered their first league loss of the season at Stonebridge Road, conceding once in each half.
The squad trains again on Monday ahead of the visit of Westfield City.
